node.title: E22 lower-scale intersection formula payload
node.statement: For every dyadic pair M_i<M_j and every subset of smaller dyadic scales, the dyadic-tree tail polynomial gives exact weighted coefficient formulas for the residual profiles raw-admissible at M_j and admissible at the selected lower scales, with atom weights supplied by dyadic_profile_evaluation.
node.attack_surface: verify the structural intersection formulas for all subsets of smaller dyadic scales, with dyadic_profile_evaluation multiplicities
node.falsifier: a missing subset, an incorrect coefficient formula, or a multiplicity mismatch with dyadic_profile_evaluation
